introduction:
Welcome to the GregTech High Pressure Safety Board.

You are applying for permission to put extremely hot gas inside pipes and then live near those pipes. The Board considers this an unusual lifestyle choice but respects your commitment.

Our previous operator left the facility in all directions. We are therefore introducing a written exam.

Answer at least 8 of the following 10 questions correctly. “It worked in another modpack” is not a recognized qualification.
passedMessage:
Congratulations! You are now a Certified High Pressure Operator.

After all that mining, crafting, and paperwork, you are finally qualified to make water angry enough to flatten an ingot. Your family must be very proud.

Please avoid testing steam exhausts and hot pipes with your face. The Board considers your health bar an ongoing part of this assessment.
failedMessage:
Certification denied.

Based on your answers, the Board expects your first practical demonstration to also be your last. Please study the material before trying again.

questions.prompt: Before firing up a Small Coal Boiler, what should you provide?
options: Coal and a written apology to the nearest village
Water and suitable fuel, because even Greg hasn't found a way to boil nothing
Fuel only, water can be added once things get exciting
A steam tank, so the boiler knows what you expect from it

questions.prompt: A Small Coal Boiler has run dry while above 100°C. What can happen if you add water while it is still hot?
options: It produces premium steam with extra confidence
The water cools it safely because water always fixes fire
It restarts normally after judging your bucket technique
It can explode and distribute your bronze investment across the neighborhood

questions.prompt: How should you deal with that hot, dry Small Coal Boiler before refilling it?
options: Stop heating it and wait for 100°C or below before refilling, however urgently you want to get back to making plates
Add water quickly before the boiler notices
Add another stack of coal to boil away the problem
Stand farther away and ask a friend to refill it

questions.prompt: What should you check when choosing a pipe for hot gas?
options: Whether its color matches the boiler
Whether the crafting recipe looked expensive enough
Gas tightness, temperature limit, and flow capacity, since Greg insists that looking like a pipe isn't enough
Whether it has already survived one explosion

questions.prompt: What can happen when a pipe that is not gas-proof carries hot steam?
options: The steam stays inside because it respects private property
It can leak hot steam and turn your plumbing into a PvP build
It automatically seals itself after receiving enough complaints
It converts the steam into harmless clouds for decoration

questions.prompt: A steam machine finished one recipe, but its exhaust is blocked by a solid block. What should you do?
options: Remove the block you placed there for aesthetic reasons and let the machine vent
Add more steam until the machine negotiates with the wall
Replace the block with a more expensive solid block
Report the wall for obstructing industrial progress

questions.prompt: Where should you stand when a steam machine vents?
options: Directly in front of the exhaust, you paid for the whole machine including the sauna
In the exhaust block, holding a bucket to catch the steam
As close as possible, the particles are merely a weather forecast
Away from the exhaust unless you're volunteering to become the next steamed recipe

questions.prompt: A Small Coal Boiler produces more steam than its internal tank can hold. What does it do?
options: Saves the extra steam in your inventory
Unlocks High Pressure II and doubles the blast radius
It vents the excess giving your hard-earned fuel a career in sound effects
Compresses the steam into a bronze ingot

questions.prompt: During a full moon, on the third Tuesday after an inspection that never took place, a north-facing boiler at Y=73, installed exactly seven blocks west of a crafting table that has only ever been used to make other crafting tables, produces steam at a steady rate of 120 L per second. Its operator is carrying 17 cobblestone, has jumped three times for calibration, and is being supervised by a chicken whose engineering qualifications are currently under investigation. Given that the server maintains exactly 20 ticks per second, the water supply is uninterrupted, the safety board has not submitted a written objection, and the operator's friend insists that his cousin gets twice as much steam using the same setup but refuses to provide screenshots, what is the boiler's average steam output per tick, assuming Greg has approved the use of division for this calculation? Assume no TPS loss.
options: 6 L/t
One bucket per emotional support session

questions.prompt: Your machines consume more steam than your boilers produce. What solves the ongoing shortage?
options: Add a bigger tank since stored steam is legally required to last forever
Produce more steam or run fewer machines, however unfair you find the concept of supply and demand
Use wider pipes to persuade the boiler to produce more
Ignore the problem, maybe it'll fix itself
